film_title: 谁害怕弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫

lines.text: 真实还是虚幻，乔治。你分不清的。／分不清，可我们也得装作分得清那样过下去。／阿门。
lines.en: Martha: Truth and illusion, George. You don't know the difference. / George: No, but we must carry on as though we did. / Martha: Amen.
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译；乔治另有变体"Truth and illusion. Who knows the difference eh, toots?"（filmsite 逐字）（核证证据：https://www.filmsite.org/whos3.html（逐字："Martha: Truth and illusion, George. You don't know the difference." "George: No, but we must carry on as though we did." "Martha: Amen."）；https://www.script-o-rama.com/movie_scripts/w/whos-afraid-of-virginia-woolf-script.html（逐字："Truth or illusion, George? Doesn't it matter to you at all?" / "Truth and illusion. You don't know the difference." / "No, but we must carry on as though we did."））

lines.text: 我是大地之母，你们全是窝囊废。
lines.en: I am the Earth Mother and you are all flops.
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译。坊间流传的"I am the earth, and the earth is me"未能在任何逐字来源核到，银幕实际台词为此句（核证证据：script-o-rama 全片剧本转写 + Tumblr 逐字引用）

lines.text: 谁害怕弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫？／我，乔治。我怕。
lines.en: Who's afraid of Virginia Woolf? / I am, George. I am.
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译；两源标点略有出入（核证证据：https://www.script-o-rama.com/movie_scripts/w/whos-afraid-of-virginia-woolf-script.html（逐字："Who's afraid of Virginia Woolf? / I am, George. I am."）；https://www.filmsite.org/whos3.html（逐字："Martha: I am George, I am."））
